chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Mufaddal ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Zurara narrated to me, from al-Harith ibn al-Mughira and Thurayh al-Muharibi, who said: Abu Abdillah said:
"Nothing remains between us and the Arabs except slaughter." And he pointed with his hand to his throat.

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah, a title for Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq mean when he said nothing remains between us and the Arabs except slaughter?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) declares that the sole remaining barrier between the Ahl al-Bayt and the Arabs is 'slaughter,' gesturing to his throat to signify imminent execution or death. This hadith, found in al-Nu'mani’s *Kitab al-Ghayba*, underscores the political tension and the eventual transition of power from the Umayyad/Abbasid Arab dominance to the Ahl al-Bayt, framing the Imams' martyrdom as a pivotal historical and spiritual threshold.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (24) Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Sa’eed narrated from Muhammad bin al-Mufadhdhal bin Ibraheem from Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Zurara from al-Harith bin al-Mugheera and Thurayh al-Muharibi that Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) had said: “
Nothing remains between us and the Arabs except slaughter. (He pointed with his hand at his mouth).”
